comments.author: @emilyneal7888
comments.text: I grew up in Louisiana in a small town that has gotten smaller, Oak Grove. The town had a billboard as you drove in. It said Welcome to Oak Grove. We grow maters, taters and state champions. I love a small town above any city. I’ve live in town with all the convenience but I’d trade it any day for a shanty outside of a small town with a good community vibe.
